run_train_model: run the parlai diplomacy training loop with all registered agents and tasks via TrainModel.main
register_all_agents: register all diplomacy agents including integration tests, generator, marginal likelihood, BART classifier, and prefix generation
register_all_tasks: register all diplomacy tasks including dialogue regular order, pseudo order, sleep classifier, and single order agents
review_train_entry_point: review the train.py entry point that wires parlai TrainModel with diplomacy agents and tasks
refactor_agent_registration: refactor the agent registration in train.py to add or remove diplomacy agent modules
